notes.title: Dev Diary 9 - Town Generation Tool - Part 1 Recreating 450BC Jerusalem
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=onoj6Jbqb_E;full][/previewyoutube]

In this Dev Diary I'm showcasing a look at a generated version of Jerusalem that, after hundreds of iterations, I am more satisfied with.

I've been developing a Town Generator Tool that could be used to semi-automatically generate the 52 towns that will be featured in Rectifying Zion. While its not possible to have the process completely work hands-off, it will definitely decrease the amount of hours to spend on each town. For this version of Jerusalem, the generation process took less than 2 hours and no further editing was done afterwards.

What the generator tool does:
- Randomly place Buildings (Sectors indicate which buildings to use in a specific area).
- Manipulate the terrain below and around each building to conform to it's doors and mesh.
- Calculate a Walk-ability Map (for painting paths on the Terrain; can also be used for NPCs).
- Calculate paths from Door to Door and Paint on the Terrain.

The generator allows adding in "landmark" buildings. This would be items like market plains, walls, gates or even roads, that the generator would be aware of and then generate the town from.

My Terrain Generator Tool helps add in the Cliff textures and Terrain Details like grass, trees and rocks.

I'm hoping to get this Town Generator Tool released on the Unity Asset Store, soon. Let me know if you are interested.

notes.title: Early Access update (Build 10.2)
notes.content:
And we're back!

When you think things are gonna go as planned they just don't. And here we are 4 months later...

Finally we have the Open World test build uploaded and ready to test for the first time.

This update is big. The Open World terrain assets are just about 15GBs alone.

While there's not much you can do [i]yet[/i], its 470 square kilometers, chunked up, and streamed from your hard drive. This opens the way for a whole lot. I'll be adding some GPS functionality to it in a next update so you can see or go to a real world location in game.

Also in this update I've added a launcher from which you will be able to open up each test build. This update now includes the Game Play build (Jerusalem area) and the Open World build. You can also view our News feed and Send feedback directly from the launcher.

The Game Play build has also been updated with minor changes with an updated character/combat and horse controller.

Please support us by purchasing Early Access or sharing with your friends!

Join our Discord server: https://discord.gg/WXbg9RHcXQ
Or join our Steam Community forum: https://steamcommunity.com/app/939610/discussions/

notes.title: Early Access update (Build 9)
notes.content:
Hay everyone!

Build 9 has been uploaded and we have a whole bunch of changes for this one.

You can now play test some weapons with new attack combos at the new Armoury area or explore the region from the Kidron Valley and Valley of Hinnom. The day and night cycle has also been enabled and improved.

Here's the list of all changes:
[list]
[*] Horse and character animations improved
[*] Horse cloth hair added
[*] Added pike and rock weapons
[*] Added attack combos
[*] Fixed bow and arrow
[*] Enabled day/night cycle (was never enabled! ːsteamfacepalmː)
[*] Added moon and improved shadows during sunset/sunrise
[*] All menus updated
[*] Added day/night cycle and day number in HUD display
[*] Added 3 fast travel locations and menu (press T or M to access)
[*] Added character stats menu (press C to access)
[*] Added controls menu
[/list]

Please test and give us feedback/comment on our Discord server or here in the Steam Community HUB.

notes.title: First Early Access WIP update (Build 8)
notes.content:
We are so excited to see people have started supporting us and many have added Rectifying Zion to their Wishlist as well. 

We have been working on a few minor updates that we decided to upload (use of the Unity GUI is a shame). The game is still raw and in early stages but we hope to progress faster as more people show their interest and support.

Here's what's changed in Build 8:
- replaced the default Unity GUI
- added a travel distance tracker (see in pause menu)
- and added some ambient sounds to the different regions (not final)

We have a  few 'Play-ground' areas planned for later updates which we would love the community to play around in, test and then give us feedback and comment on our Discord server or here in the Steam Community HUB.

Join our Discord server: https://discord.gg/WXbg9RHcXQ
Or join our Steam Community forum: https://steamcommunity.com/app/939610/discussions/
